// before.go.txt is the pre-fix text of internal/review/mutate_test.go's leftover
// check, plus the two other spellings the same mistake takes. It is a .txt so the
// package it sits in does not compile it; the scanner reads it as source.
package fixture

import (
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// The shape that cost #1341 twice, #1345 and #1360: snapshot the SHARED temp
// directory, run, and refuse anything that was not there before. A sibling job on
// the same runner making its own nova-review-mutate-* between the two listings
// reddens this for something it never did.
func TestRemovesItsWorktree(t *testing.T) {
	prior := map[string]bool{}
	was, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "nova-review-mutate-*"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, p := range was {
		prior[p] = true
	}
	mutate(t)
	entries, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "nova-review-mutate-*"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, p := range entries {
		if !prior[p] {
			t.Fatalf("a temp worktree directory was left behind: %s", p)
		}
	}
}

// The same read one hop away: the shared directory arrives through a local.
func TestReadsTheTempDirThroughAVariable(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.TempDir()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("something is in %s", root)
	}
}

// And the pre-1.16 spelling, which is the same listing under another name.
func TestReadsTheTempDirThroughIoutil(t *testing.T) {
	entries, err := ioutil.ReadDir(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "nova"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("left behind")
	}
}

// The narrowings, all silent here on purpose: a stat of ONE named path in the
// shared directory is a question about that path, and no sibling can answer it
// wrongly; and a listing of a directory this test made itself is its own.
func TestTheNarrowings(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "nova-review-mutate-1")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("still there")
	}
	mine := t.TempDir()
	if _, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(mine, "*")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func mutate(t *testing.T) { t.Helper() }
